units.text: 1. units.text: 1. Conducting foreign economic operations involving goods, information, work, services or results of intellectual activity (rights thereto) that may be used to create weapons of mass destruction, their delivery systems, other weapons and military equipment, or to prepare and/or carry out terrorist acts, and that are subject to export controls, without a special permit (licence) where one is mandatory, or in breach of the requirements (conditions or restrictions) laid down in the permit (licence); or using an unlawfully obtained permit (licence), or submitting documents containing inaccurate information, except in the cases provided for by Articles 16.1, 16.3 and 16.19 of this Code, —
